followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the official incoming-freight diversion at Stasylos. The domestic station’s continuing operation does not negate the cross-border restriction. The current phase remains Belarus-to-Lithuania freight, diverted to Kena. The regulator supports a broader-direction follow-up, but does not justify silently changing this incoming-only phase or adding passenger scope. 16 February to 26 April 2023 remains a qualified 69-day policy lower bound. Equipment targets, a July 2024 decision and a 2025 designated-crossing list do not establish reopening or later confirmation. Explicit anti-smuggling and associated security statements support Security/Smuggling coding. No economic-protection rationale is inferred. The ministry page was freshly read. Saved border-service, RRT and EU passages were inspected with direct-access limits intact. Ministry/VSAT material is related, and the two RRT paths identify one decision. The crossing remains unlocated, with one-way incoming-freight scope. No domestic station coordinate or broader railway line is substituted.

Retain both quarantine decisions and all existing source/date/continuity/geographic limits. Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.

release_review.adjudication: Accept the fixed sixteen-parent audit, covering all21currentphases and96claimdomains. Apply seven guarded baseline cell refinements: cancellation/nonimplementation wording forSUP-004, local-resident reopening scope for quarantinedR3-SC-004, and correlated schedule alternatives forSUP-002 so a false0–2day range is not calculated. Retain both quarantine decisions and all existing source/date/continuity/geographic limits. Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.
